"""Preflight and launch one guarded native hierarchy export; archive after use."""
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
sys.path.insert(0, "syn")
from tri_oracle_artifact_fingerprint import artifact_fingerprint

root = Path.cwd()
producer = json.loads(Path("records/sram_core_checkpoint44_qualification.json").read_text())
checkpoint = Path(producer["database"] if "database" in producer else producer["output_database"])
expected = producer.get("database_fingerprint", producer.get("output_database_fingerprint"))
assert expected is not None and artifact_fingerprint(checkpoint) == expected
assert producer["cell_count"] == 94471
cold = json.loads(Path("records/sram_core_cold_reload54_qualification.json").read_text())
assert cold["physical_report_closure_passed"]
report = Path(".cache/physical/pnr/tri_oracle_sram_memory_compute/qualification_cold_reload_54")
coverage = (report / "constraint_coverage_slow.rpt").read_text()
unconstrained = [m[1] for m in re.finditer(
    r"(?m)^\s*(\S+)\s+Unconstrained signal arriving at end point\s+setup_slow\s*$", coverage)]
reset = {name for name in unconstrained if name.endswith("/CDN")}
mask = {name for name in unconstrained if re.fullmatch(r"masks\[[01]\]/BWEB\[\d+\]", name)}
assert len(unconstrained) == 5007 and len(reset) == 4751 and len(mask) == 256
assert len(reset | mask) == len(unconstrained)
sdc = checkpoint / "mmmc/modes/functional/functional.sdc"
commands = sdc.read_text().splitlines()
def ports(command):
    return {re.search(r"\[get_ports\s+\{([^}]+)\}\]", line)[1]
            for line in commands if line.startswith(command)}
no_drive = {m[1] for m in re.finditer(
    r"(?m)^\s*(\S+)\s+No drive assertion\s+setup_slow\s*$", coverage)}
assert len(no_drive) == 2126
assert no_drive == ports("set_input_transition") | {"clk", "rst_n"}
assert ports("set_input_delay") == no_drive - {"clk", "rst_n"}
assert len(ports("set_output_delay")) == 1032
assert ports("set_false_path") == {"rst_n"}
assert [l.strip() for l in commands if l.startswith("set_false_path")] == [
    "set_false_path  -from [get_ports {rst_n}]"]
missing_delay = re.findall(r"(?m)^\s*(\S+)\s+No input delay assertion with respect to clock\s+setup_slow\s*$", coverage)
assert missing_delay == ["rst_n"]

# Independently trace every actual mask write-enable connection through the
# exported buffer/tie graph. Names suggesting a tie are insufficient evidence.
netlist = (report / "routed_netlist.v").read_text()
driver = {}
kinds = set()
for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^\s+(BUFF\w+|CKBD\w+|TIEL\w+)\s+(\S+)\s*\(([^;]*)\)\s*;", netlist, re.S):
    connections = {p[1]: p[2].strip() for p in re.finditer(r"\.(\w+)\s*\(([^()]*)\)", m[3])}
    if m[1].startswith("TIEL"):
        assert set(connections) == {"ZN"}
        destination, origin = connections["ZN"], None
    else:
        assert set(connections) == {"I", "Z"}
        destination, origin = connections["Z"], connections["I"]
    assert destination not in driver
    driver[destination] = (origin, m[1])
    kinds.add(m[1])
mask_nets = []
for m in re.finditer(r"TS5N28HPCPSVTA32X128M2FW\s+\\masks\[([01])\]\s*\(([^;]*)\)\s*;", netlist, re.S):
    connection = re.search(r"\.BWEB\((.*?)\)", m[2], re.S)[1].strip()
    assert connection.startswith("{") and connection.endswith("}")
    nets = [x.strip() for x in connection[1:-1].split(",")]
    assert len(nets) == 128
    mask_nets.extend(nets)
assert len(mask_nets) == 256
visited_kinds = set()
for net in mask_nets:
    visited = set()
    while net is not None:
        assert net not in visited and net in driver, net
        visited.add(net)
        net, kind = driver[net]
        visited_kinds.add(kind)
libpath = Path(".cache/physical/library/tcbn28hpcplusbwp12t40p140tt1v25c.lib")
liberty = libpath.read_text()
for kind in visited_kinds:
    match = re.search(r"\bcell\s*\(\s*" + re.escape(kind) + r"\s*\)\s*\{", liberty)
    assert match
    cursor, depth = match.end(), 1
    while depth:
        depth += (liberty[cursor] == "{") - (liberty[cursor] == "}")
        cursor += 1
    body = liberty[match.end():cursor - 1]
    functions = re.findall(r'\bfunction\s*:\s*"([^"\n]+)"\s*;', body)
    assert functions == (["0"] if kind.startswith("TIEL") else ["I"]), (kind, functions)

# Complete independent physical-netlist reset proof, including optimized
# paired inverters. Verify actual Liberty functions, not name-based polarity.
from tri_oracle_ideal_clock import _mask, _MODULE, _INSTANCE, _connections
reset_edges = {}
reset_pins = []
for module in _MODULE.finditer(_mask(netlist)):
    for instance in _INSTANCE.finditer(module[2]):
        ports_actual = {k: v[0].strip() for k, v in _connections(instance, 0).items()}
        if "CDN" in ports_actual:
            reset_pins.append((instance[2], ports_actual["CDN"]))
        if set(ports_actual) in ({"I", "Z"}, {"I", "ZN"}):
            output = "Z" if "Z" in ports_actual else "ZN"
            assert ports_actual[output] not in reset_edges
            reset_edges[ports_actual[output]] = (
                ports_actual["I"], int(output == "ZN"), instance[1])
reset_cache = {}
reset_functions = {}
def reset_parity(net, seen):
    if net == "rst_n":
        return 0
    if net in reset_cache:
        return reset_cache[net]
    assert net not in seen and net in reset_edges, net
    parent, inverted, kind = reset_edges[net]
    assert kind not in reset_functions or reset_functions[kind] == inverted
    reset_functions[kind] = inverted
    result = reset_parity(parent, seen | {net}) ^ inverted
    reset_cache[net] = result
    return result
assert len(reset_pins) == 4751
assert all(reset_parity(net, set()) == 0 for _, net in reset_pins)
assert reset_functions == {
    "BUFFD1BWP12T40P140": 0, "BUFFD2BWP12T40P140": 0,
    "CKND3BWP12T40P140": 1, "INVD0BWP12T40P140": 1,
    "INVD1BWP12T40P140": 1, "INVD2BWP12T40P140": 1}
for kind, inverted in reset_functions.items():
    match = re.search(r"\bcell\s*\(\s*" + re.escape(kind) + r"\s*\)\s*\{", liberty)
    assert match
    cursor, depth = match.end(), 1
    while depth:
        depth += (liberty[cursor] == "{") - (liberty[cursor] == "}")
        cursor += 1
    functions = re.findall(r'\bfunction\s*:\s*"([^"\n]+)"\s*;', liberty[match.end():cursor-1])
    assert functions == (["(!I)"] if inverted else ["I"]), (kind, functions)

available = int(next(l.split()[1] for l in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines()
                     if l.startswith("MemAvailable:"))) * 1024
assert available > 12 * 1024**3
evidence = {
    "all_5007_unconstrained_endpoints_classified": True,
    "asynchronous_reset_endpoints": 4751,
    "all_reset_polarities_noninverting_in_independent_netlist_graph": True,
    "reset_trace_nets": len(reset_cache),
    "reset_cell_inversions_verified_from_actual_liberty": reset_functions,
    "constant_zero_mask_write_enable_endpoints": 256,
    "mask_tie_trace_cell_types": sorted(visited_kinds),
    "all_2126_no_drive_inputs_classified": True,
    "nonclock_nonreset_inputs_with_explicit_transition_and_delay": 2124,
    "outputs_with_explicit_delay": 1032,
    "only_input_without_delay": "rst_n; explicitly false-pathed asynchronous reset",
    "native_reset_startpoint_check": "Required in export Tcl before model generation",
    "source_database": str(checkpoint),
    "source_database_fingerprint_verified": True,
    "source_sha256": {str(p): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                      for p in (sdc, report / "constraint_coverage_slow.rpt",
                                report / "routed_netlist.v", libpath)},
    "scope": "Coverage classification under the original constraints; no relaxed limit or new timing exception"
}
Path("records/sram_core_hierarchy58_coverage_preflight.json").write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + "\n")
os.environ.pop("TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_OUTPUT", None)
os.environ.update(
    TRI_ORACLE_TOP="tri_oracle_sram_memory_compute",
    TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_STAGE="hierarchy_export_58",
    TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_ENTRY="syn/tri_oracle_export_sram_core_hierarchy_reset_polarity.tcl",
    TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_MARKER="TRI_ORACLE_SRAM_CORE_HIERARCHY58_EXPORTED",
    TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_OUTPUT=".cache/physical/pnr/tri_oracle_sram_memory_compute/hierarchy_export_58",
    TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_ANON_GIB="14", TRI_ORACLE_PHYSICAL_SECONDS="3600")
print("Coverage preflight passed; launching native model export", flush=True)
os.execvpe("bash", ["bash", "syn/run_tri_oracle_guarded_physical.sh"], os.environ)
